run_label: reduced run: CPU, small data, not comparable to target

timing_probe.scope: measured on generated training images immediately before the full fit; not used to select thresholds or inspect held-out test performance

yolo.autoanchor_note: Pinned YOLOv5 train.py calls check_anchors unless --noautoanchor is set. It attempts anchor evolution when Best Possible Recall is <= 0.98. This ratio-fit check passes for the minimum raster box, but the box remains smaller than the stride-eight feature cell, so localization recall must be measured.

snr_definition: 10*log10(total clean signal power / total added noise power over the full I/Q segment)

runtime_seconds_pipeline.note: Measured end-to-end runtime on the configured execution device.

processing_time_per_segment_local_second.note: Not measured on the owner's local machine; a hosted CPU timing is not a substitute.

shifted_test.distribution: bandwidth uniform [0.02, 0.12]; global SNR uniform [-5, 5] dB

support.low_support_rule: Any per-class or per-SNR cell with fewer than 30 signals is marked low_support.
support.pam_zero_db_bin: [0, 1) dB because the generator draws a continuous SNR; inspect support before interpreting.
